content:
Amanda K: Ok team — need to originate an RC for the hotpatch fixing stray NPE in tokenizer. Candidate branch: release/hotfix/tokenizer-rc. Can we create candidate and pin artifact?
Raj P: ack. I can cut the candidate. Will trigger CI and smoke.
ci-bot: CI triggered for release/hotfix/tokenizer-rc — build 8842 queued.
Miguel R: quick question — does this include the kv-cache tweak from yesterday or is that a separate change?
Amanda K: only the tokenizer NPE fix + test adjustments. kv-cache tweak is out of scope for this RC.
Sara L: starting a minimal eval set on the candidate after CI passes. I’ll post results.
ci-bot: build 8842 succeeded — artifacts: rtk-tokenizer-8842.tar.gz (sha256: d4c3b2e1).
deploy-bot: Candidate created: rc/8842 pinned to artifact rtk-tokenizer-8842.tar.gz. Can promote to canary once QA + oncall ack. Use `/deploy promote --rc rc/8842 --staged canary` to start.
Amanda K: QA and oncall — can we do a brief smoke window at 11:30-11:50 PST? It’s within the change window and minimal traffic.
oncall-sheriff: I’m on duty and available for the 11:30 slot. I’ll monitor error rates and latency.
qa-bot: QA runs started on rc/8842 — smoke tests: unit, integration, basic latency.
Sara L: smoke passing so far (integration & unit ok). Latency looks normal in staging. Posting short logs:```ok tests: 127 passed, 0 failed```
Raj P: rollforward plan prepared: if errors > 1% or cpu spike > 20% in 10m, immediate rollback to rc/8799 and open incident. Otherwise, continue rollout.
Amanda K: rollback command handy: `/deploy rollback --to rc/8799 --reason "tokenizer hotfix rollback"` — keep me copied.
Miguel R: quick config note — we’ll pin model weights to avoid runtime kernel selection variance: add label `weight_pin=true` on the candidate.
deploy-bot: Label applied to rc/8842: weight_pin=true.
Sara L: final QA: smoke + sample prompt eval run. Sent sample eval diff to #eng-releases for eyeball. No regressions observed.
Raj P: initiating staged canary promote now. `/deploy promote --rc rc/8842 --staged canary --percentage 5 --duration 15m --monitor error_rate,latency`
deploy-bot: Promotion started — rc/8842 -> canary. Traffic 5% for 15m. Monitoring hooks enabled (error_rate, latency).
oncall-sheriff: monitoring dashboard looks green at +5m. No error alerts. Keeping close watch.
ci-bot: Canary smoke checks: pass. No exceptions in logs.
Sara L: continuing sample eval during canary hold — no semantic regressions in 50 prompts.
Raj P: okay to lift to 25% for 30m if canary stays clean. Amanda?
Amanda K: yes go for 25%. Notify me if anything looks off.
Raj P: `/deploy promote --rc rc/8842 --staged canary --percentage 25 --duration 30m`
deploy-bot: Promotion update — rc/8842 -> canary at 25% for 30m.
oncall-sheriff: still green at +20m. Error rate stable, p95 latency unchanged.
Sara L: final QA thumbs up. No regressions.
Raj P: preparing final promo to prod at 12:25 PST (end of change window buffer). Rollback playbook ready.
Amanda K: final check: docs/relnotes: add short note "Fix tokenizer NPE causing occasional 500s on long prefix." I’ll sign off.
Amanda K: /me signs off on rc/8842 for prod promotion at 12:25 PST.
Miguel R: noted. I’ll be available for the rollback exec if needed.
Raj P: executing final promote at 12:25. `/deploy promote --rc rc/8842 --to prod --staged 100 --monitor error_rate,latency --notify #eng-oncall`
deploy-bot: Promotion to prod started — rc/8842 promoting. Rolling sequentially across regions.
ci-bot: post-deploy health checks passed in us-west-2.
oncall-sheriff: Watching prod dashboard — two minor 502 spikes immediately after switch (20s each), auto-recovered. No escalation.
Amanda K: seeing the same, looks transient. Monitoring continues.
Raj P: if we see sustained >1% errors for 5m, execute rollback. Otherwise we consider this green.
Sara L: confirming no semantic drift in edge evals.
deploy-bot: Promotion complete — rc/8842 is now active in prod. Release notes: "tokenizer NPE hotfix".
Amanda K: thank you team — closing the RC thread. Will follow up with a brief post-deploy note in release notes doc. :tada:
